mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.email, u.display_name, u.password_hash, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user_sessions s JOIN app_users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE app_users SET display_name = #{displayName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
